game: JAX @ ARI Week 12 2025, kickoff 2025-11-23 16:05 ET, ARI +2.5, total 47.5, roof closed

script.base: Books have a one-score game: JAX implied 25.0, ARI 22.5, spread only 2.5 so this is not a 3.5+ dropback-dog or a blowout. Dome, both WR1s already out (Brian Thomas Jr., Marvin Harrison Jr.). JAX leans on Travis Etienne (57 carries, 215 rush yards in weeks 9-11) and Parker Washington (18 targets). ARI, without Emari Demercado and Trey Benson, funnels through Trey McBride (33 targets, 297 yards) and Michael Wilson (29 targets, 280 yards) with Jacoby Brissett. Starters should finish.
script.flip1: JAX leads by two scores early, clocks Etienne, and ARI abandons the run. Knight/Carter carries die; Brissett volume spikes and McBride/Wilson yardage overs become the live side while JAX pass-catchers stall.
script.flip2: ARI's short OL (Hayden Conner out, Kelvin Beachum and Will Hernandez questionable) collapses even with Travon Walker out. Brissett cannot hold the ball, Wilson's air yards (325 over three games) die, and the game becomes a low-efficiency grind under 47.5. A second flip is ARI jumping ahead and running, which stalls both pass overs.

injury_fallout: Known from the pre-game nflverse injury report, not from inactives (those are not in the pack). ARI: Marvin Harrison Jr. out removes 22 targets and 129 yards from weeks 9-11; the on-field alphas are already McBride (33/297/261 air) and Wilson (29/280/325 air), with Elijah Higgins (9/60) and Greg Dortch (last4 5, 0, 0, 66) as smaller shares. Emari Demercado out (23 carries, 151 yards, 6.57 YPC) and Trey Benson out leave Bam Knight (24/79, 3.29 YPC) and Michael Carter (5 rush carries, 7 targets). Safety Dadrion Taylor-Demerson out and CBs Garrett Williams and Will Johnson questionable; LB Baron Browning out; G Hayden Conner out. JAX: Brian Thomas Jr. out but he had only 5 targets/55 yards in the three-game sample; Washington (18/143) is already the target leader ahead of Jakobi Meyers (9/105) and Dyami Brown (9/25 on 159 air). Etienne keeps the carry lead over Bhayshul Tuten (28/108). OT Anton Harrison out is a rush-efficiency and protection hit. DE Travon Walker out and LB Yasir Abdullah out are the defensive losses that help ARI's pass game, especially the TE. Questionable tags (Strange, Lewis, Jones, Beachum, Hernandez, Robinson) are not outs.

matchup.shell: No man/zone or MOFO/MOFC chart in the pack. Location proxy, 10 games: ARI middle 8.14 YPA (73 attempts) vs left 6.9 (134) and right 6.32 (132). JAX is even-to-tight: left 6.88 (147), middle 6.48 (80), right 6.79 (139).
matchup.pressure: ARI blitz rate 23%; JAX EPA/db +0.11 when blitzed and -0.08 when not, so Jacksonville is fine if Arizona brings extra. JAX blitz rate 33%; ARI EPA/db +0.05 vs blitz and +0.06 vs none. Walker being out means the 33% blitz may not become real pressure. ARI OL injuries are the pressure risk the other way.
matchup.bleeds: ARI bleeds the middle and the run (4.67 YPC, 35 runs of 10+ in 10 games) more than the outside. JAX bleeds explosives (33 passes of 20+ for 381 yards) more than any one zone; the middle is their best area, and the run defense is the tighter unit (4.18 YPC, 20 runs of 10+).
matchup.overlap: McBride's seam/volume role overlaps the missing JAX linebacker (Abdullah), not a middle YPA bleed. Wilson's 325 air yards overlap JAX's explosive-pass leak and a banged-up corner group that is only questionable. Washington overlaps ARI's middle leak and the missing safety, but his recent 33- and 20-yard games do not confirm it, so he is not an edge player.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost because the 185-yard Wilson game was one explosive script, JAX's questionable corners played and took the outside away, and McBride was held in the 55-yard range again while Jacksonville's middle (their best YPA zone) sat on the seam. ARI's OL, already without Conner and possibly without Beachum and Hernandez, let pressure through even with Walker out, so Brissett dumped to Knight and the yardage lines died on empty targets. The other real loss is that 25.5 and 66.5 were never bettable prices — the pack itself marks no two-sided market — so a 'win' on a median stand-in would not have been a real edge. That price counter is strong enough to refuse a stake. It is not stronger than the role read, so the legs stay flagged rather than dropped.
slip_story: One script only: ARI pass funnel in a closed-roof one-score game with Harrison, Demercado and Benson out. Wilson recyds over 25.5 with McBride recyds over 66.5. Do not add Knight rush over, a game under, a TD, or a second market on either player. Washington/Etienne is a different JAX story and stays off this slip. No bet is placed.
